$description: Dark tints — Phase 1 (charcoal*/grayLight/rustLight/magentaLight) and Phase 2 status roles (graySubtle..crimsonBorder). Each is the *same hue* as its light-mode counterpart, only re-lightened for a dark surface — never a new color family. The Phase 1 set introduced brand-new names (no light-mode equivalent exists). The Phase 2 status set reuses the *same primitive names* as tokens/color.primitive.json on purpose: both themes need a value for these, so this file overrides them the same way tokens/themes/dark/color.semantic.json already overrides semantic paths — the dark StyleDictionary instance's `source` layer wins over `include`.

charcoalRaised.$description: bg.surface — a raised neutral against the charcoal page. 1.20:1 vs page, matching (scaled up for dark) the light theme's own 1.05-1.16:1 surface step.

charcoalSubtle.$description: bg.subtle — hover/zebra, one step up from charcoalRaised. 1.47:1 vs page.

charcoalBorder.$description: border.default. Phase 4 STOP 1: #564349 was 1.99:1 vs page, 1.66:1 vs charcoalRaised — under the 3:1 control-boundary floor on both. Lightened, same warm hue: 3.76:1 vs page, 3.13:1 vs charcoalRaised.

grayLight.$description: text.muted — lightened gray, 6.46:1 vs page (light theme's gray-on-cream is 6.66:1 — matched).

rustLight.$description: brand.link — lightened rust. Plain rust is only 3.35:1 on charcoal (fails AA text); this hits 5.11:1, matching light theme's 5.16:1 rust-on-cream.

magentaLight.$description: focus.ring — lightened magenta. Plain magenta is only 2.54:1 on charcoal (fails WCAG 2.4.11's 3:1 floor for a focus indicator); this hits 4.30:1.

plumLight.$description: text.heading — lightened plum. Plain plum is only 1.41:1 on charcoal (fails even the 3:1 large-text floor); this hits 11.9:1 vs bg.page, 10.0:1 vs bg.surface.

inkCaptionLight.$description: text.caption — lightened ink. Phase 4 STOP 2: light theme's inkCaption (rgba(26,20,22,0.6)) had no dark override at all, so dark reused the light value verbatim — 1.00:1 vs bg.page, 1.11:1 vs bg.surface, effectively invisible. This hits 6.00:1 vs bg.page, 5.00:1 vs bg.surface.

tealSubtle.$description: status.infoSubtle fill (dark). Retuned to brand teal. 1.66:1 vs bg.page.
